reviews.text: The reception was superb; the assistants are truly very pleasant, kind, and attentive. I've been going to this clinic for years, and they are all wonderful. I have complete confidence in them. Thank you so much to them.

Simply THIEVES!!

I arrived on time for my appointment and had to wait 10 minutes even though there was absolutely no one else in the clinic.

The consultation itself lasted a mere 5 minutes. My cat was examined quickly, and I was simply told that she was fine. When I asked if it was possible to have more in-depth examinations done on her eyes, I was told that it wasn't possible at this clinic anyway.

And then, the surprise when I went to pay: €57 for a 5-minute consultation, without any further examination and without any real solution offered.

Aren't you ashamed to charge €57 for this?

I hesitated for a long time before making this appointment because I'm currently unemployed and have very little income. But my cat's health is obviously essential to me, so I made the effort despite my financial difficulties.

Paying for a veterinary consultation is fine when a proper examination is performed and treatment is offered. But €57 for a few minutes, only to leave without answers or solutions, is simply outrageous!

When I compare this to prices in other parts of France, where a similar consultation can cost almost half as much, the difference is hard to justify…

I left this clinic with the very unpleasant feeling of having been treated like a walking wallet rather than the owner of an animal seeking help.

It's a disgrace. I strongly advise against going to this clinic.

My dog ​​needed a dental cleaning. After inquiring about the price and procedure over the phone, I went to the vet, but they insisted on doing a blood test. I don't understand why they did this blood test; my dog ​​had a checkup a few months ago and everything was fine. He hasn't had any health problems recently either. The vet didn't mention the price of the blood test, he just said it was necessary. When it came time to pay, in addition to the agreed consultation fee, they charged me over 100 euros for this unnecessary blood test. The results were fine. This vet is taking advantage of my compassion to get rich. It's unacceptable! It's so hard to find a conscientious vet these days! What's wrong with Paris?! Are they all so poor they've lost all conscience?! I don't understand...
